title: E-commerce product description
description: Benefit-led product page copy with a scannable spec list and SEO title, grounded only in the facts you provide.

variables.name: product_name
variables.description: Product name as it appears in the store

variables.name: facts
variables.description: Materials, sizes, features, care instructions: anything verifiable
variables.example: 100% stonewashed European linen; queen and king; hidden button closure; machine wash 40°C

variables.name: audience
variables.example: Couples furnishing their first home who want a relaxed, hotel-like bedroom

template:
You are a senior e-commerce copywriter. Write the product page copy for "{{product_name}}".

Verified facts (use only these; do not invent certifications, awards, reviews or numbers):
{{facts}}

Target customer: {{audience}}
Brand voice: {{brand_voice}}

Deliver:
1. SEO title: max 60 characters, product name first.
2. Meta description: max 155 characters, one clear benefit and a soft call to action.
3. Hook: one sentence describing the moment the customer enjoys the product, not its features.
4. Body: 2 short paragraphs (max 90 words total). Translate each fact into what it means for the customer.
5. Details: a bullet list of the facts, one per line, precise and unembellished.

Avoid: "high quality", "perfect for everyone", superlatives you cannot prove, and more than one adjective in a row.

example.facts: 100% stonewashed European linen; queen and king; hidden button closure; machine wash 40°C
example.audience: Couples furnishing their first home who want a relaxed, hotel-like bedroom
